claim: Fails when the CSV is saved with Indonesian settings: Excel and LibreOffice set to Indonesian save CSV with ";" as the separator, and prices are often written "Rp1.500.000.000" or "1,5 M". claim: Fails when the owner's age limits the tenor: an expert's first question is "how old will you be when the loan ends?". BCA allows at most 25 years and the borrower may be at most 65 (employee) or 66 (self-employed) at loan end. The plan uses a fixed 20-year tenor with no age rule, so for a 50-year-old owner the real tenor is 15 years and the real installment about 20% higher than shown; a house passes that the bank will refuse.
chain: then the shortlist shows installments for a tenor the bank will not give
and then the owner shortlists a house that fails the bank's 30% test, the failure D-004 says must not happen
fix: Decide: (a) add "usia saat ini" (stored locally) and a per-bank "usia maksimal saat lunas" (default 65), and cap the tenor at that age; or (b) keep tenor manual and show a warning line next to the tenor field about the age-at-loan-end rule.

verify.manual: F-02 names the age-at-loan-end rule and how the tenor is capped or warned

claim: Fails when the builder starts: the plan says to use the distro Python 3.14.4 and Django 6.1.3 but gives no install line and no virtual environment. Under PEP 668 (Final) a distro-managed Python refuses a global "pip install django" (externally-managed-environment), so the start command fails on day one.

evidence.quote: Use the installed Python 3.14.4 (S5.q3), supported to 2030-10

chain: then the builder installs with --break-system-packages or sudo pip
and then a later system update breaks Django or the system Python, and the one-command start (S2.q6) stops working
fix: Add the install line to S5 and the handover: python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/pip install "Django==6.1.3"; start with .venv/bin/python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. Fallback when PyPI is unreachable: a saved wheel in the project folder.
